question: Among all cards with full artwork and a black border, what percentage are only available in online game variations? Additionally, for these cards, list their original release dates and legal play formats if they are mythic rarity and have a defined release date.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.XCL_001, c.XCL_004, c.XCL_059, s.XCL_112
  FROM cards AS c
  INNER JOIN sets AS s ON c.XCL_063 = s.XCL_099
  WHERE c.XCL_018 = 'extendedart'
    AND c.XCL_005 = 'black'
),
pct AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_004 = 'mtgo' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(XCL_001) AS online_only_percentage
  FROM base
)
SELECT p.online_only_percentage, b.XCL_112 AS release_date, l.XCL_084 AS legal_format
FROM pct AS p
CROSS JOIN base AS b
INNER JOIN legalities AS l ON b.XCL_001 = l.XCL_086
WHERE b.XCL_004 = 'mtgo'
  AND b.XCL_059 = 'mythic'
  AND b.XCL_112 IS NOT NULL
  AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH filtered_cards AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_072 AS card_id,
        c.XCL_012 AS rarity,
        s.XCL_112 AS release_date,
        l.XCL_085 AS format,
        l.XCL_084 AS legality
    FROM cards c
    JOIN sets s ON c.XCL_013 = s.XCL_095
    LEFT JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
    WHERE c.XCL_015 = 'full'
      AND c.XCL_016 = 'black'
),
online_only_cards AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fc.card_id
    FROM filtered_cards fc
    WHERE fc.format = 'online'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 
          FROM legalities l2 
          WHERE l2.XCL_086 = fc.card_id 
            AND l2.XCL_085 != 'online'
      )
),
percentage_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT card_id) FROM online_only_cards) * 100.0 / 
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT card_id) FROM filtered_cards) AS percentage
)
SELECT 
    pc.percentage,
    fc.card_id,
    fc.release_date,
    fc.format
FROM percentage_calc pc
CROSS JOIN filtered_cards fc
WHERE fc.card_id IN (SELECT card_id FROM online_only_cards)
  AND fc.rarity = 'mythic'
  AND fc.release_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY fc.card_id
